from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,json,re,shutil,sys
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tool/playback_benchmark'))
from resources import summarize_trials,summarize_disposed_memory
from lifetime_windows import validate_window
from memory_categories import parse_vmmap
from memory_mapping import read_memory,untagged_regions
from run_address_history import select_target
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def archive(path,final):
 out=path/'run';r=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text());p=json.loads((path/'history-probes.json').read_text())
 rows=[json.loads(l.split('YL_RESOURCE_SERIES=',1)[1]) for l in (out/'playback.log').read_text().splitlines() if 'YL_RESOURCE_SERIES=' in l]
 assert rows==r['observations']==[json.loads(l) for l in (out/'observations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
 assert summarize_trials(rows)==r['summary'];assert summarize_disposed_memory(rows)==r['disposedMemory']
 assert sha(path/'protocol.json')==p['protocolSha256']
 protocol=json.loads((path/'protocol.json').read_text());assert sha(path/'flutter-history')==protocol['wrapperSha256']
 assert sha(out/'resources.dylib')==r['samplerSha256']
 assert all(sha(out/n)==m['sha256'] and (out/n).stat().st_size==m['bytes'] for n,m in r['logs'].items())
 assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(r['sourceFingerprints'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()==r['sourceHash']
 if final:
  assert all(sha(root/n)==h for group in ('sourceFingerprints','dependencies','artifactFingerprints') for n,h in r[group].items())
  assert sha(root/'packages/yl_player/example/assets/test_media/format_matrix/mkv-avc-aac.mkv')==r['mediaHash']
 markers={(m['attempt'],m['phase'],m['edge']):m for m in p['markers']};history=[]
 for rec in p['records']:
  key=(rec['attempt'],rec['phase']);assert validate_window(markers.get((*key,'begin')),markers.get((*key,'end')),rec)==rec['qualified']
  if 'raw' not in rec:continue
  f=out/rec['raw']['file'];text=f.read_text();assert sha(f)==rec['raw']['sha256'] and f.stat().st_size==rec['raw']['bytes']
  if rec['tool']=='vmmap' and rec['status']=='captured':
   assert parse_vmmap(text,rec['pid'])==rec['summary'];assert untagged_regions(text,rec['pid'])==rec['untaggedRegions']
   if key==(1,'live'):assert select_target(rec['untaggedRegions'])==p['target']
  if rec['tool']=='dart-memory' and rec['status']=='captured':
   payload=json.loads(text);replies=iter(payload['rpc'])
   def replay(method,params):
    reply=next(replies);assert reply['method']==method and reply['params']==params
    return reply['response'].get('result',reply['response'])
   assert read_memory(replay,rec['pid'],include_system=True)==rec['memory']==payload['memory']
   journal=out/rec['rpcJournal']['file'];assert sha(journal)==rec['rpcJournal']['sha256'];assert journal.stat().st_size==rec['rpcJournal']['bytes']
   events=[json.loads(l) for l in journal.read_text().splitlines()]
   for i,reply in enumerate(payload['rpc'],1):
    es=[e for e in events if e['sequence']==i];assert es[0]['stage']=='request' and es[0]['params']==reply['params'];assert es[1]['httpStatus']==reply['httpStatus']
    assert json.loads(b''.join(base64.b64decode(e['data']) for e in es if e['stage']=='body'))==reply['response']
  if rec['tool'].startswith('history-'):
   matched=[]
   matches=list(re.finditer(r'^(VM_ALLOC|VM_DEALLOC|ALLOC|FREE) (0x[0-9a-f]+)-(0x[0-9a-f]+) \[size=(\d+)\]:[^\n]*\n',text,re.M))
   for i,m in enumerate(matches):
    lo,hi,size=int(m[2],16),int(m[3],16)+1,int(m[4]);assert hi-lo==size;assert lo<=int(rec['address'],16)<hi
    matched.append(dict(event=m[1],start=hex(lo),endExclusive=hex(hi),bytes=size,stack=text[m.end():matches[i+1].start() if i+1<len(matches) else len(text)]))
   history.append(dict(attempt=rec['attempt'],phase=rec['phase'],address=rec['address'],qualified=rec['qualified'],events=matched))
 raw={}
 for f in sorted(path.rglob('*')):
  if not f.is_file() or f.suffix=='.dylib':continue
  raw[str(f.relative_to(path))]=dict(sha256=sha(f),bytes=f.stat().st_size,text=f.read_text())
 dest=root/'.superpowers/sdd/2026-09-26-remaining-08-performance-release'/('system-address-final' if final else 'system-address-preliminary')
 shutil.copytree(path,dest)
 return dict(run=r,probes=p,protocol=protocol,history=history,rawFiles=raw)
preliminary=archive(Path('/private/tmp/yl-system-address-20261007'),False)
final=archive(Path('/private/tmp/yl-system-address-final-20261007'),True)
app=root/'packages/yl_player/example/build/macos/Build/Products/Profile/yl_player_example.app/Contents/MacOS/yl_player_example'
f=Path(__file__)
evidence=dict(schemaVersion=1,purpose='system-groups-and-bounded-untagged-history',preliminary=preliminary,final=final,
 appExecutable=dict(path=str(app.relative_to(root)),sha256=sha(app)),
 archiveScript=dict(sha256=sha(f),bytes=f.stat().st_size,text=f.read_text()),
 sourceIdentityVerifiedAgain=True,performanceBaseline=False,budgetAdmission=False,leakVerdict=None,physicalOutput='not_verified')
p=root/'tool/playback_benchmark/macos-system-address-observations.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(evidence,indent=2)+'\n');print('archived',p.stat().st_size,'bytes')
